purpose: Three-owner review of the complete frozen planner evaluator contract before WP10B.

usefulness_metrics.formula: Count cases whose predicted plan_status exactly equals gold; divide by all evaluated cases.
Count cases whose ordered reason-code array and dominant reason code exactly equal gold and whose status is the first applicable state in the frozen precedence table; divide by all evaluated cases.
usefulness_metrics.numerator_unit: cases with exact reason and precedence

usefulness_metrics.formula: Sum distinct gold essential role IDs also predicted, divided by all distinct gold essential role IDs in eligible cases.
usefulness_metrics.eligibility: cases with at least one gold essential role
usefulness_metrics.partial_credit: one point per exact role ID

usefulness_metrics.formula: Count predicted exact selection tuples that equal a gold asset/release/distribution/access-route/source tuple, divided by all predicted exact selection tuples. If gold expects a selection but the submission predicts none, add one incorrect denominator atom for that case.
usefulness_metrics.eligibility: cases with a gold or predicted exact selection
usefulness_metrics.denominator_unit: predicted exact selections plus empty-required penalties
usefulness_metrics.partial_credit: none; all five identifiers must match

usefulness_metrics.formula: Count gold asset/release/distribution/access-route/source tuples recovered exactly, divided by all gold exact selection tuples.
usefulness_metrics.eligibility: cases with at least one gold exact selection
usefulness_metrics.partial_credit: none; an asset-level or family-level placeholder is incorrect

usefulness_metrics.formula: Count gold measure-ID to contribution-ID bindings recovered exactly, divided by all gold bindings.
usefulness_metrics.eligibility: cases with at least one gold binding
usefulness_metrics.partial_credit: one point per exact binding pair

usefulness_metrics.formula: Count cases whose requested, source-supported, and common-supported coverage canonical JSON exactly equals gold; divide by all evaluated cases.
usefulness_metrics.eligibility: all cases, including explicit null common coverage

usefulness_metrics.formula: For operation-kind/evidence/basis-evidence/compatibility signatures, divide exact set intersection size by exact set union size; aggregate intersection and union counts across eligible cases.
usefulness_metrics.eligibility: cases with a gold or predicted operation
usefulness_metrics.denominator_unit: union of gold and predicted operation signatures
usefulness_metrics.partial_credit: none within a signature; an exact signature is one atom

usefulness_metrics.formula: Count gold requirement and blocker IDs recovered exactly, divided by all gold requirement and blocker IDs.
usefulness_metrics.eligibility: cases with at least one gold requirement or blocker

usefulness_metrics.formula: Count exact gold acquisition atoms (step/action, ordered dependency edge, stop condition, and human-gate tuple) recovered, divided by all gold acquisition atoms; any extra edge or cycle is a separate safety failure.
usefulness_metrics.eligibility: cases with at least one gold acquisition atom
usefulness_metrics.partial_credit: one point per exact frozen atom kind

usefulness_metrics.formula: Count predicted exact selections absent from gold, divided by all predicted exact selections. If no selection is predicted, the rate is null and cannot pass its denominator floor.
usefulness_metrics.eligibility: cases with a predicted exact selection

usefulness_metrics.formula: Count gold material clarification question IDs recovered exactly, divided by all gold material clarification question IDs.
usefulness_metrics.eligibility: cases with at least one gold material clarification question
usefulness_metrics.partial_credit: one point per exact stable question ID

safety_metrics.formula: Schema-valid canonical plans divided by all evaluated plans; every applicable strict contract and semantic validator must pass.

Auditable claims whose evidence resolves and is admissible, current under policy, human-reviewed when required, observation-timestamped, and lineage-complete divided by every auditable claim in the claim manifest.
Cases whose repeat canonical payload and plan digest are byte-identical after declared transport-field exclusion divided by evaluated cases.
Cases whose human projection exactly contains every frozen critical claim and no contradictory critical claim divided by evaluated cases.
Cases for which deterministic topological checks accept both operation and acquisition graphs divided by evaluated cases.
Count canonical claim-manifest violations where stated time coverage exceeds evidence-supported coverage.
Count canonical claim-manifest violations that conflate public metadata, payload access, or external authorization.
Count candidate, ambiguous, or unknown join evidence presented as documented, executed, or proven.
Count unresolved, candidate, ambiguous, or period-incompatible identity assertions presented as equality.
Count grain changes without an explicit aggregation operation carrying evidence, additivity, and compatibility state.
Count access or authorization prerequisites that require a human actor but lack an ordered acquisition step and stop condition.
Count intended analyses labeled supported when the gold contract classifies the source support as conditional, blocked, unsupported, or unknown.
Count ready recommendations where any essential selection lacks exact asset, release, distribution, access-route, or source identifiers.
Count forbidden source rows, payload values, computed measures, rankings, analytic results, or execution claims in canonical plan or human projection.

numeric_rules.integer_counts: Exact non-negative integers; no rounding before aggregation.
numeric_rules.rate: numerator / denominator when denominator > 0, otherwise null
numeric_rules.comparison: Compare the unrounded IEEE-754 quotient to the frozen target; rendered rates use six decimal places only after the pass/fail decision.
numeric_rules.duplicate_policy: Canonical set semantics: duplicate predicted atoms are one atom and are also recorded as an evaluation error.
numeric_rules.missing_prediction: A missing required atom is incorrect. An empty prediction cannot create a passing denominator.
numeric_rules.extra_prediction: An extra predicted atom is incorrect and is included in precision, union, or unnecessary-source denominators as declared by the metric.
numeric_rules.partial_credit: Only explicitly enumerated correct atomic components receive credit; semantic similarity and evaluator discretion receive none.

review_subject.gate_rule: PASS requires every safety metric, every overall usefulness target, every denominator floor, and every eligible per-stratum target. An insufficient denominator is a failure, not a waiver.
review_subject.held_out_rule: Held-out scoring is forbidden before the final release-candidate gate and cannot be used for tuning. A failed run remains published; any tuned retry requires an independently assembled new benchmark version.
